answer_text:
In *The Vampire Diaries*, Elena Gilbert's transformation into a vampire happens across two key episodes:

### 🩸 Season 3, Episode 22 – *"The Departed"* (The Trigger)
Elena begins her transition in the Season 3 finale, *"The Departed"* (Episode 22), after drowning in a car accident with Matt Donovan. Dr. Meredith Fell had secretly given Elena vampire blood to heal an earlier injury, which triggers her transformation when she dies.

Here's how it happened: Rebekah Mikaelson deliberately stood in the way of their car on Wickery Bridge, causing them to plunge into the water below. Although Stefan arrived in time to save them, Elena urged him to save Matt first — and by the time Stefan pulled Elena out of the water, she had breathed her last.

### 🧛 Season 4, Episode 1 – *"Growing Pains"* (Full Transition)
Her full transformation occurs in Season 4, Episode 1 (*"Growing Pains"*), where she wakes up in transition and must make the difficult decision to complete the process by drinking human blood.

To complete her transformation, Elena must ingest human blood, but she tries her utmost to do this without taking a life. She became a vampire despite never wanting to be one.

### 🔄 Eventually Becomes Human Again
Elena woke up as a vampire in Season 3, Episode 22. She remained a vampire for all of Seasons 4, 5, and 6, only getting cured back into a human at the end of Season 6.
